findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): SensorManager reads the gravity vector to steer the snake; it is not health data and is never transmitted off-device
findings.evidence: GravityController.kt registers a SensorEventListener for Sensor.TYPE_GRAVITY (fallback TYPE_ACCELEROMETER) with SENSOR_DELAY_FASTEST and passes x/y values only to TiltController, which drives snake direction in memory. No network, storage, logger upload or share intent is involved. The SensorManager pattern match is a false positive for the HEALTH data type.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration for HEALTH is needed. Motion and orientation sensor data processed only on-device is not collected. Keep it that way: do not log these values to a remote logger.
